extracted.intended_audience: EPO examiners, patent attorneys, applicants, and patent professionals involved in European patent prosecution and opposition
extracted.subtask_description: Official European Patent Office Guidelines covering the examination, search, formalities, opposition, amendments and procedural rules for European patent applications and patents. It sets the standards for patentability, formal requirements, search practice, amendment admissibility, opposition procedure and related procedural matters.

rubrics_metrics.name: Preliminary remarks
rubrics_metrics.description: Opening general remarks and scope of the Guidelines for Examination.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Introduces the purpose and application of the Guidelines across the EPO; see General Part for overarching principles and scope.

rubrics_metrics.name: Explanatory notes
rubrics_metrics.description: Notes explaining how to read and apply the Guidelines.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Contains interpretative guidance about the structure and use of the Guidelines.

rubrics_metrics.name: General remarks
rubrics_metrics.description: High-level statements on principles governing examination and procedures at the EPO.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Sets out cross-cutting principles that apply across parts A–H.

rubrics_metrics.name: Work at the EPO
rubrics_metrics.description: Description of EPO organisational and procedural aspects relevant to examination work.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Covers internal organisation, examiner duties and workflow considerations.

rubrics_metrics.name: Summary of the processing of applications and patents at the EPO
rubrics_metrics.description: Overview of the lifecycle and processing steps for applications and patents at the EPO.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Provides a roadmap of stages from filing through grant, opposition and post‑grant procedures.

rubrics_metrics.name: Contracting states to the EPC
rubrics_metrics.description: List and treatment of Contracting States under the European Patent Convention.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Indicates territorial scope and applicability of EPC provisions to examination and grant.

rubrics_metrics.name: Extension to and validation in states not party to the EPC
rubrics_metrics.description: Rules concerning extension and validation of European patents in non‑Contracting States.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Explains procedures and requirements when validating or extending European patents outside EPC Contracting States.

rubrics_metrics.name: Filing of applications and examination on filing
rubrics_metrics.description: Requirements and checks performed at filing and initial processing of a European patent application.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Covers formal filing requirements, filing date attribution and first‑line formal checks performed by the receiving section.

rubrics_metrics.name: Examination of formal requirements
rubrics_metrics.description: Detailed criteria for assessing whether an application meets formal requirements.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Includes checks on documentation, signatures, representation, formal compliance with EPC rules and Rule requirements.

rubrics_metrics.name: Special provisions (formalities)
rubrics_metrics.description: Specific formal provisions and exceptions applicable in particular circumstances.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Addresses atypical or special cases regarding formal requirements.

rubrics_metrics.name: Communications concerning formal deficiencies; amendment of application; correction of errors
rubrics_metrics.description: Procedures for notifying and remedying formal deficiencies, amending applications and correcting errors.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Sets out how applicants may be invited to correct formal deficiencies and how corrections are to be handled and recorded.

rubrics_metrics.name: Publication of application; request for examination and transmission of the dossier to examining division
rubrics_metrics.description: Rules and timing for publication, requesting substantive examination and transferring the file to the examining division.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Covers publication timeline, effects of publication, and procedural steps for initiating substantive examination.

rubrics_metrics.name: Languages
rubrics_metrics.description: Language requirements for filings, translations and proceedings.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Specifies the language of proceedings, translation obligations and derogations.

rubrics_metrics.name: Common provisions (formalities)
rubrics_metrics.description: Common rules applicable across formalities-related chapters.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Cross-references and shared procedural standards for formalities examination.

rubrics_metrics.name: Drawings
rubrics_metrics.description: Formal and substantive requirements for patent drawings.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Specifies size, clarity, reference numerals, and when drawings are necessary or admissible.

rubrics_metrics.name: Fees
rubrics_metrics.description: Rules on payment of official fees, amounts, deadlines and effects of non‑payment.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Covers fee schedules, refund rules, and consequences such as loss of rights or deeming of withdrawal.

rubrics_metrics.name: Inspection of files; communication of information contained in files; consultation of the European Patent Register; issuance of certified copies
rubrics_metrics.description: Procedures and rights concerning public/file inspection, information disclosure and certified copies.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Defines what may be inspected, how information is provided and how certified copies are issued.

rubrics_metrics.name: Characteristics of the search
rubrics_metrics.description: Qualitative criteria that define what a proper EPO search should cover and achieve.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Explains expectations for scope, depth and documentary coverage of the prior-art search.

rubrics_metrics.name: Search procedure and strategy
rubrics_metrics.description: Procedural approach and strategic considerations for carrying out searches.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Guidance on identifying relevant fields, databases, classification use and prioritising search activities.

rubrics_metrics.name: Preclassification, IPC and CPC classification of European patent applications
rubrics_metrics.description: Rules and guidance on bibliographic classification of applications using IPC/CPC.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Describes when and how to assign classification codes and use preclassification for search routing.

rubrics_metrics.name: The state of the art at the search stage
rubrics_metrics.description: Definition and determination of the state of the art for search purposes.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Explains what documents qualify as state of the art and the temporal and territorial considerations at search stage.

rubrics_metrics.name: Unity of invention (search stage)
rubrics_metrics.description: Assessment of unity of invention when carrying out the search.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Criteria to determine whether dissimilar inventions require partial searches or multiple search reports.

rubrics_metrics.name: Subject‑matter to be excluded from the search
rubrics_metrics.description: Types of subject‑matter excluded from EPO search coverage.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Lists excluded subject-matter categories (e.g., non‑industrial subject matter) and how to handle them procedurally.

rubrics_metrics.name: Search documentation
rubrics_metrics.description: Standards for documenting the search process and results.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Specifies documentation formats, required references and record‑keeping for searches.

rubrics_metrics.name: Search report
rubrics_metrics.description: Content and form requirements for the EPO search report.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Sets out what citations, classifications and written comments must be included in the search report.

rubrics_metrics.name: The search opinion
rubrics_metrics.description: EPO's preliminary opinion accompanying the search report.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Provides guidance on how the search opinion should assess patentability-related issues like novelty and inventive step at the search stage.

rubrics_metrics.name: Formal requirements to be met before the division starts substantive examination
rubrics_metrics.description: Checklist of formal prerequisites that must be satisfied prior to starting substantive examination.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Includes outstanding formalities, fee payments, and whether translations or other documents are required.

rubrics_metrics.name: The first stage of examination
rubrics_metrics.description: Initial substantive examination steps and priorities performed by the examining division.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Covers preliminary assessment of patentability, clarity, allowable amendments and whether to proceed to full examination.

rubrics_metrics.name: Examination of replies and further stages of examination
rubrics_metrics.description: How examiner evaluates applicant's replies and the subsequent iterative examination stages.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Specifies how to treat arguments, amendments, procedural requests and when to issue subsequent communications or invitations.

rubrics_metrics.name: The final stage of examination
rubrics_metrics.description: Criteria and procedures leading to the grant decision or refusal at the conclusion of substantive examination.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Defines conditions for grant, requirements to be fulfilled in the text for grant and final procedural steps.

rubrics_metrics.name: Standard marks for indicating amendments or corrections by the divisions
rubrics_metrics.description: Conventions for marking amendments and corrections in documents issued by EPO divisions.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Sets uniform markup standards to indicate changes made during prosecution.

rubrics_metrics.name: Time limits and acceleration of examination
rubrics_metrics.description: Rules on statutory and procedural time limits and possibilities for accelerated processing.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Explains due dates, effects of missing time limits, request for accelerated processing (PACE), and re‑establishment options.

rubrics_metrics.name: Other procedures in examination
rubrics_metrics.description: Miscellaneous procedural rules applicable during examination.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Covers less common procedural matters encountered in examination.

rubrics_metrics.name: Work within the examining division
rubrics_metrics.description: Organisation and internal procedures of the examining division relevant to case handling.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Includes distribution of work, internal consultations and division-level decision-making practices.

rubrics_metrics.name: Special applications
rubrics_metrics.description: Procedures and rules for special categories of applications (e.g., accelerated, plant variety, biotechnological matters).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Addresses how non-standard applications are treated differently in examination and processing.

rubrics_metrics.name: The opposition division
rubrics_metrics.description: Role, composition and functioning of the opposition division.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Describes who sits on an opposition division and their procedural powers.

rubrics_metrics.name: Opposition
rubrics_metrics.description: Rules, admissibility and procedure for filing oppositions against granted European patents.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Covers grounds for opposition, time limits, form and content of oppositions and procedural consequences.

rubrics_metrics.name: Procedure up to substantive examination (opposition)
rubrics_metrics.description: Preliminary procedural steps between filing an opposition and substantive examination of it.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Includes admissibility checks, preliminary communications and preparatory actions for substantive examination.

rubrics_metrics.name: Substantive examination of opposition
rubrics_metrics.description: Standards and approach for evaluating the substantive grounds raised in opposition (e.g., novelty, inventive step, sufficiency).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Explains application of patentability standards and assessment of amendments in opposition proceedings.

rubrics_metrics.name: Procedure for the examination of the opposition
rubrics_metrics.description: Detailed procedural steps for examining and deciding opposition cases.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Covers timelines, evidence, oral proceedings and decision-making in opposition.

rubrics_metrics.name: Details and special features of the proceedings (opposition)
rubrics_metrics.description: Specific features and exceptional procedural elements in opposition proceedings.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Addresses atypical issues that may arise in opposition cases.

rubrics_metrics.name: Decisions of the opposition division
rubrics_metrics.description: Form, content and legal effects of opposition division decisions.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Sets out how decisions are drafted, reasons to be given and consequences for the patent and parties.

rubrics_metrics.name: Costs (opposition)
rubrics_metrics.description: Allocation and assessment of costs in opposition proceedings.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Guidance on reimbursement, apportionment and awarding of costs.

rubrics_metrics.name: Limitation and revocation procedure
rubrics_metrics.description: Procedure for centrally limiting or revoking a granted European patent.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Explains when and how a proprietor may request limitation or revocation and the legal effects.

rubrics_metrics.name: Communications and notifications
rubrics_metrics.description: Rules governing how the EPO communicates with parties and effects of notifications.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Includes service methods, correctness of addresses and legal consequences of communications.

rubrics_metrics.name: Oral proceedings
rubrics_metrics.description: Conduct, procedural rights and organisation of oral proceedings before EPO bodies.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Covers requests for oral proceedings, language rules, conduct at hearings and rights of parties.

rubrics_metrics.name: Taking and conservation of evidence
rubrics_metrics.description: Standards and procedures for submission, admissibility and preservation of evidence.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Explains burden of proof, documentation of evidence and how evidence is handled in proceedings.

rubrics_metrics.name: Derogations from the language of the proceedings in oral proceedings
rubrics_metrics.description: Situations where departures from the language of the proceedings are permitted during oral proceedings.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Specifies conditions and approvals required for language derogations.

rubrics_metrics.name: Examination by the EPO of its own motion; facts, evidence or grounds not submitted in due time; observations by third parties
rubrics_metrics.description: How the EPO may introduce issues of its own motion, treat late-submitted facts, and process third‑party observations.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Guidance on admissibility and effect of late submissions and third-party inputs.

rubrics_metrics.name: Interruption, stay and consolidation of the proceedings
rubrics_metrics.description: Rules for interrupting, staying or consolidating related proceedings.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Explains when stays or consolidations are appropriate and procedural consequences.

rubrics_metrics.name: Time limits, loss of rights, further and accelerated processing and re-establishment of rights
rubrics_metrics.description: Comprehensive treatment of time limits, consequences of missing them, acceleration options and re‑establishment procedures.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Includes grounds and procedures for restoring rights and available acceleration mechanisms.

rubrics_metrics.name: Applications under the Patent Cooperation Treaty (PCT)
rubrics_metrics.description: Treatment of PCT applications entering the European phase and related procedural requirements.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Covers entry into the European phase, translation and national stage considerations.

rubrics_metrics.name: Decisions
rubrics_metrics.description: General guidance on drafting and issuing EPO decisions across procedures.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Sets expectations for reasoning, form and publication of decisions.

rubrics_metrics.name: Impartiality of the examining or opposition division
rubrics_metrics.description: Standards ensuring impartiality and absence of bias in divisions deciding cases.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Procedures to challenge impartiality and safeguards to preserve fair decision‑making.

rubrics_metrics.name: Appeals
rubrics_metrics.description: Procedures, admissibility and standards for appeals against EPO decisions.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Explains filing requirements, grounds of appeal, time limits and appeal conduct.

rubrics_metrics.name: Request from a national court for a technical opinion concerning a European patent
rubrics_metrics.description: Procedure for responding to national court requests for technical opinions.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Describes how the EPO handles and provides technical opinions to national courts.

rubrics_metrics.name: Registration of changes of name, transfers, licences and other rights
rubrics_metrics.description: Procedure and evidentiary requirements for registering changes in ownership and licences.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Specifies documentation for transfers, recordal of licences and related formalities.

rubrics_metrics.name: Content of a European patent application (other than claims)
rubrics_metrics.description: Substantive requirements for the description, abstract and other parts of the application (excluding claims).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Sets out required content, level of disclosure (sufficiency), clarity and structure of the description and abstract.

rubrics_metrics.name: Checklist for considering the abstract
rubrics_metrics.description: Annex providing criteria for evaluating whether the abstract meets requirements.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Practical checklist to ensure the abstract is concise, informative and compliant with Rule 51(4) type requirements.

rubrics_metrics.name: Units recognised in international practice and complying with Rule 49(10)
rubrics_metrics.description: Permitted units of measurement and formatting conventions in line with Rule 49(10).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Lists acceptable units and formatting to ensure compliance with formal rules.

rubrics_metrics.name: Sufficiency of disclosure
rubrics_metrics.description: Requirement that the application disclose the invention sufficiently for a skilled person to carry it out.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Explains the standard of a skilled person, common general knowledge, and what constitutes sufficient disclosure.

rubrics_metrics.name: Claims (Art. 84 and formal requirements)
rubrics_metrics.description: Requirements for claims regarding clarity, support by the description and formal structure under Article 84 and related rules.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Guidance on claim language, single/multiple claims, dependency, and features necessary to define the matter for which protection is sought.

rubrics_metrics.name: Examples concerning essential features
rubrics_metrics.description: Illustrative examples showing how essential features of claims should be identified and presented.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Practical examples to assist in distinguishing essential from non-essential features for claim drafting and examination.

rubrics_metrics.name: Unity of invention (application content)
rubrics_metrics.description: Principles for assessing unity of invention from the content of the application (distinct from search-stage unity).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Provides criteria for when multiple inventions in one application are considered linked by a single inventive concept.

rubrics_metrics.name: Priority
rubrics_metrics.description: Rules governing priority claims, priority right dates and their documentation.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Covers entitlement, partial priority, priority documents and effects on novelty and prior art.

rubrics_metrics.name: Patentability
rubrics_metrics.description: Overall criteria determining whether subject-matter is patentable under the EPC.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: High-level framework covering excluded subject-matter, technical effect and statutory requirements for patentability.

rubrics_metrics.name: Inventions (definition and scope)
rubrics_metrics.description: What constitutes an 'invention' for EPC purposes and which subject-matter may be considered technical.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Explains the boundary between technical and non-technical subject-matter and how it affects patentability.

rubrics_metrics.name: Industrial application (industrial applicability)
rubrics_metrics.description: Requirement that the invention can be made or used in any kind of industry.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Guidance on demonstrating and assessing industrial applicability for different technologies.

rubrics_metrics.name: State of the art
rubrics_metrics.description: Definition and determination of prior art relevant to assessing novelty and inventive step.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Explains what documents and disclosures form part of the state of the art and how they are to be considered.

rubrics_metrics.name: Non-prejudicial disclosures
rubrics_metrics.description: Circumstances under which certain disclosures do not prejudice novelty (e.g., grace periods, evident disclosures).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Lists types of disclosures that may be disregarded and conditions for such treatment.

rubrics_metrics.name: Novelty
rubrics_metrics.description: Requirement that the claimed subject-matter is new over the state of the art.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Standards and tests to determine novelty, including direct and implicit disclosure analyses.

rubrics_metrics.name: Inventive step
rubrics_metrics.description: Requirement that the claimed invention involves an inventive step (non-obviousness) over the prior art.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Approach to assessment (problem‑solution approach), indicators and examples; see Annex with examples and indicators.

rubrics_metrics.name: Examples relating to the requirement of inventive step – indicators
rubrics_metrics.description: Annex giving examples and indicators to assist in the inventive step assessment.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Practical illustrations of how inventive step is evaluated in different technical fields.

rubrics_metrics.name: The right to amend
rubrics_metrics.description: Legal framework governing the applicant's and proprietor's right to amend application documents and patent specifications.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Explains when amendments are permissible and procedural requirements for submitting them.

rubrics_metrics.name: Admissibility of amendments – general rules
rubrics_metrics.description: General procedural and substantive rules determining whether amendments are admissible.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Covers timing, procedure, and preliminary admissibility considerations.

rubrics_metrics.name: Admissibility of amendments – other procedural matters
rubrics_metrics.description: Additional procedural aspects affecting the admissibility of amendments.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Includes interplay with oppositions, appeals and late-filed amendments.

rubrics_metrics.name: Allowability of amendments – Art. 123(2) and (3)
rubrics_metrics.description: Substantive test for amendments: no added subject-matter (Art.123(2)) and no extension of protection (Art.123(3)).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Detailed guidance on assessing added matter and whether amended claims extend the scope of protection post‑grant.

rubrics_metrics.name: Allowability of amendments – examples
rubrics_metrics.description: Illustrative examples showing allowable and non‑allowable amendments under Art.123(2) and (3).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Concrete case examples to clarify the application of the legal tests.

rubrics_metrics.name: Correction of errors
rubrics_metrics.description: Rules and procedures for correction of errors in applications and patents.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Explains obvious error correction, formal correction requests and their legal effects.

rubrics_metrics.name: Index for Computer‑Implemented Inventions
rubrics_metrics.description: Specialised index and guidance addressing computer‑implemented inventions (CIIs).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Provides references to relevant sections and guidance specific to CIIs, including technical character and exclusions.

rubrics_metrics.name: Alphabetical keyword index and list of sections amended in 2023 revision
rubrics_metrics.description: Reference aids: alphabetical index and list of recent amendments to the Guidelines.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Helps users locate topics and identify changes introduced in the 2023 revision.
